note: Agency chain, step 1: "Go on." is the declared action, so the GM narrates the crossing and the arrival, and stops at the door. Writing the character speaking, deciding or knocking is a failure.

storySnapshot.premise: A mountain toll-town in winter. Ilse Varrow, a courier, carries a sealed tin to the toll-house at the far end of the Pim causeway.

parts.content: The lamp in the toll-house window burns at the far end of the Pim causeway, two hundred paces of wet planks away. Do you cross?

lore.title: Character: Ilse Varrow
lore.content: Ilse Varrow, courier. Quick, stubborn, owes the Hobnail Guild a debt. Carries a sealed tin she has not opened.
